title: Rick E NDE 22100
content: At the age of five, my father had to slam on the brakes. I hit my head on the gear shifter of the car. The next thing I knew, I was floating about thirty feet above the car. After that, my mother was shaking me to wake up. I had a big bruise on my forehead for days afterward. I thought it was a dream until I started learning about astral projection. My question was, ‘How many five year olds know what a street and Chevrolet look like from thirty feet up?’ After studying the subject of astral projection, I learned how to wake up my consciousness in a dream. After practicing dreaming this way, I would often wake up vibrating extensively. After weeks of this happening, I gave into the vibrations. I was floating across the room. It seemed as if I could see in all directions or was at least aware of what was around me. I could feel a little wind pushing me when I moved. I did not have much control in my movements. I did not do this again. I woke up in the vibration stage many times afterward. The last time I did, I prayed that it would go away. I did from that day on and never came back.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt "vibrating extensively" before floating; felt a "little wind pushing" when moving; had limited control and felt aware of surroundings/able to "see in all directions."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car stopped suddenly; hit head on the gear shifter; bruise on forehead afterward.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Later describes deliberate/learned astral projection-like episodes with vibrations and floating across the room (not clearly tied to the age-5 injury event).
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeatedly woke in a "vibration stage" and once "gave into the vibrations" and floated across the room; later prayed for it to stop.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Narrative includes both an accident-related OBE at age five and later intentional/learned astral projection episodes featuring a recurring "vibration stage," floating across a room, 360-degree awareness, and feeling wind while moving; stopping after praying for it to go away.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating about thirty feet above the car.” “It seemed as if I could see in all directions or was at least aware of what was around me.” “After practicing dreaming this way, I would often wake up vibrating extensively.” “I could feel a little wind pushing me when I moved.” “The last time I did, I prayed that it would go away. I did from that day on and never came back.”
